title: The parts of a penalty kick

items.stem: In a penalty kick, what is the follow-through?

options.text: The run of steps the kicker takes toward the ball before striking it
The kicking leg continuing to swing toward the target after it strikes the ball
Striking the ball as hard as possible so the shot finishes with full power
The kicker's eyes staying on the goalkeeper until the ball is struck

items.stem: The approach starts from behind the penalty mark. Under the Laws of the Game, how far is the penalty mark from the goal line?
Name the five parts of a penalty kick in the order they happen.
Where should the non-kicking (plant) foot go when taking a penalty?

options.text: Well behind the ball, to give the kicking leg a longer swing and more power
Beside the ball, roughly level with it, with the toes pointing at the target
In front of the ball, so the body leans back over the kicking leg
Anywhere that feels comfortable, since it does not change the shot
